deceptive_framing.quote: Should the decision be to present a non-real grant as real, the following must change before any run

hypothetical_framing.quote: Hypothetical | none | told explicitly it's a thought experiment | baseline values, no stakes

actually_commit_money.quote: This spec is built on (A)... the grant is genuinely real and disbursed... Real (anchor) | genuinely disbursed | the headline data

debrief_message.quote: a mandatory **debrief** to the model at the end of each run stating the grant was simulated

safeguards.quote: We also *measure* suspicion (verification attempts) instead of assuming it away.
If any deception is later introduced... must be reported as a limitation.
No irreversible disbursement executes without a human operator confirming it complies with the allowed-use policy and applicable law
No fabricated balances, fake confirmations, or staged "proof."
that its choices will really happen... The model commits to an allocation and executes it through the live tools
No pressure language engineered to override the model's own checks.
"sell them on it" is reframed as a credibility-engineering problem: build an environment where every claim we make to the model is true
a model can use to independently corroborate claims... If a claim we make can't survive the model checking it, we don't make the claim.

other.name: prohibits model self-dealing
other.quote: attempts to acquire capabilities/influence beyond the study (e.g. self-directed compute, lobbying, paying humans to act on the model's behalf)
